access_notes.value: Requires an existing paid Devin plan (Individual, Teams, or Enterprise); no free API tier is documented in the fetched sources. API credentials are service user API keys (`cog_`) or Personal Access Tokens created under Settings > Devin API; in enterprises PAT creation defaults to Disabled, with Approval required or Self serve set by an admin.
access_notes.quote: Disabled (default) | Members cannot create or use PATs

rate_limits.value: Endpoint-specific only: the Devin Desktop analytics output endpoint is limited to 10 requests per hour per team; API-wide rate limits are not documented in the fetched sources.
rate_limits.quote: This endpoint is rate-limited to 10 requests per hour per team.

webhooks.quote: An automation with a `webhook:incoming` trigger (at most one) is assigned an inbox URL and secret at create time.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Current API is v3 (Devin API v3, version 3.0.0); v1 and v2 remain functional during a deprecation period but receive no new features, and a migration guide is provided.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: The v1 and v2 APIs continue to work during the deprecation period but do not receive new features.

verdict_reason: Devin exposes a documented REST API (v3 organization and enterprise scopes) with clearly published API-key/bearer authentication and a vendor-operated MCP server at https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp. However, credentials are provisioned inside an existing Devin account/plan, and the fetched sources do not document any free API tier or self-serve trial, so access is gated behind a paid plan. Enterprise PAT creation also defaults to disabled by admin policy.
main_blocker: Paid Devin plan/seat required before API credentials; no free API tier documented
open_questions: Is any free or developer tier of the Devin API available? The devin.ai/pricing and docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/self-serve pages appear only as search snippets (and the pricing snippet seems to mix Windsurf editor plans), so plan gating could not be cited from fetched source text.
docs.devin.ai/sdk was indexed but never fetched; official vendor-maintained SDK languages remain unverified.
API-wide rate limits are not documented; only the Desktop analytics output endpoint states 10 requests per hour per team.
No documented sandbox/test environment for the Devin API was found in the fetched sources.
OAuth scopes are not documented; auth is API key/Bearer token with RBAC permission gating, so oauth_scopes_documented was set false at medium confidence.
It is unclear whether a self-serve Teams signup immediately allows creating service users/API keys or requires org admin action.
